freezeAnchor.rule: The commit that first adds this artifact is the prospective protocol freeze. Only exact AP McCoy passive observations strictly later than that commit timestamp may enter the survival ledger.

whyLatencyAgnostic: Choosing an action-latency threshold after observing which post-GHT windows survived would bias the race estimate. Every complete cycle therefore records the full bounded post-GHT state path without selecting a latency. A later independently frozen latency may classify every retained reviewed cycle deterministically; cycles cannot be included or excluded based on that latency.

cycleMustContinueUntil: or the predeclared observation horizon ends

frozenOutputs.lastConfirmedUnawardedLagSeconds: latest retained state with unchanged winCount, unchanged guaranteedHitTime and nondecreasing amount, measured from GHT
frozenOutputs.firstObservedAwardOrResetLagSeconds: first retained state with changed winCount, decreased amount or changed guaranteedHitTime, if observed

laterDeterministicClassification.successAtLatencyL: cycle has confirmed unchanged/unreset state at or after detectionTimestamp + L
laterDeterministicClassification.failureAtLatencyL: award/reset is observed strictly before detectionTimestamp + L
laterDeterministicClassification.ambiguousAtLatencyL: observation gaps or censoring do not establish either condition

executionSeparation.reason: Post-GHT survival is a passive server-state property. Exact served stake and its review are required for economic/execution evaluation but not for observing how long the overdue network state remains unawarded.
